Name: Nyapu's Style - Old Wizard for RRRR
Author: Jupm
Description:
[size=5][b][center][color=#8e7cc3]Nyapu's Style - Old Wizard for RRRR[/color][/center][/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod is a 'replacer', meaning you will have to replace the existing PNGs in the RRRR mod with these new ones.
[/size][size=3]This mod makes the wizard portraits from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] mod appear in Nyapu style.

This mod contains all the hairstyles available in the original mod, as well as the seasonal clothing.

[/size][size=3]How to install: just replace the "portraits" folder of the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url]" mod with the folder containing my drawings. After that, all done! Now just play!

Thank you so much [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Jellonip?gameId=1303]Jellonip[/url] for this amazing mod! Even after years of playing with it, I never get tired of marrying Magnus![/size]
